{{Recipe summary
| Category = Potato recipes
| Servings = 4
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Israel|Cuisine of Israel]]
==Ingredients==
*4 large [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]]
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], [[Cookbook:Beating|beaten]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Matzo Meal|Matzo meal]], [[Cookbook:Corn|corn meal]], or [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
*[[Cookbook:Applesauce|Applesauce]] and/or [[Cookbook:Sour cream|sour cream]]

==Procedure==
#Peel and [[Cookbook:Grater|grate]] potatoes and onion.
#Mix potato and onion with egg, matzo meal, and salt.
#Heat oil in a 10-inch pan over medium heat until it is quite hot. Drop 1–2 tablespoons of the potato mixture onto the pan per pancake. Turn once to allow both sides to fry.
#Serve with applesauce and/or sour cream as a topping.

==See also==
*[[Cookbook:Latkes|Latkes]]
